reference: Focused candidate contracts; man-db comparison is provided by the parity VM cases.

cases.purpose: Exercise apropos query semantics on a private whatis index.
cases.script:
export MANPATH=. BASHMAN_STALE_QUIET=1
printf '%s\n' 'alpha, aleph (1) - first apple' 'alpha-x (1) - longer name' 'beta (1) - second berry' 'both (1) - alpha and beta' > whatis
apropos -- "^al.ha, "
